R0236.title: Payment Tokenization Misconfiguration
R0236.definition: Payment tokens, card substitutes, or binding relationships are misconfigured, causing unauthorized charges or data exposure.
R0236.description:
Payment tokenization misconfiguration occurs when card substitutes, payment tokens, binding relationships, or merchant domain isolation are configured incorrectly. Attackers may reuse, enumerate, or use tokens across contexts to make unauthorized charges.

Tokenization reduces exposure of raw card numbers, but does not replace authorization boundaries. Payment systems must validate token scope, device binding, merchant binding, transaction context, and lifecycle.
R0236.influence: Token boundary errors can enable unauthorized charges, incorrect binding relationships, and exposure of sensitive payment data.
